\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

Explain the system context and the technical question you investigate.
Clarify why the question matters, what baseline you start from, what you change,
and the main result or trade-off you observe.

\section{System and Technical Approach}
\label{sec:approach}

Describe only the supplied components needed to understand your investigation,
then explain what you completed, modified, or added. Make the technical question
and design choices precise.

\section{Experimental Methodology}
\label{sec:methodology}

Describe the data, baseline(s), metrics, hardware/software setup, experimental
procedure, and controls needed to understand and reproduce your comparison.
Your evaluation should include an appropriate quality/correctness measure and
an appropriate systems-cost measure.

\section{Results and Analysis}
\label{sec:results}

Present evidence for a small number of precise claims. Analyse why the observed
behaviour occurs, including trade-offs, negative or unexpected results, and
alternative explanations where relevant.

\section{Discussion and Conclusion}
\label{sec:conclusion}

Summarise what was learned, the most important quality--cost trade-offs,
limitations, and what you would change or investigate next.
